news.title: As lockout looms, MLB raises minimum salary offer while union eyes media deals
news.summary: MLB suggested more measures Monday to get players paid earlier in their careers while the players union agreed to share local media equally among the 30 teams.

news.title: Big Apple blockbuster: Mets, Skubal reach record 9-year, $450M contract, sources say
news.summary: Tarik Skubal and the Mets agreed to a nine-year, $450 million contract, sources told ESPN. It is the richest deal for a pitcher, both by total and average annual value.

news.title: Source: Mets agree to 1-year deal with veteran 1B Goldschmidt
news.summary: The New York Mets continued their spending spree Monday by coming to terms on a one-year deal with first baseman Paul Goldschmidt, a source told ESPN, a day after agreeing to give Tarik Skubal the lar...

news.title: Sources: Yankees continue to strengthen bullpen, sign Suter to 1-year, $4M deal
news.summary: The Yankees and left-handed reliever Brent Suter are in agreement on a one-year, $4 million contract with a club option for 2028, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan on Monday.

news.title: Brewers receive full playoff share of $493,044; total pool down from 2025
news.summary: A full postseason share for the World Series champion Milwaukee Brewers was $493,044, and the total players' pool amount of roughly $114.5 million was down from the previous two seasons.
